name: What is a curbless shower and why is it recommended for accessibility?

mainEntity.name: What is a curbless shower and why is it recommended for accessibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: A curbless shower has no raised edge or curb, allowing for a seamless transition from the bathroom floor directly into the shower area. This design eliminates a tripping hazard and allows for easy entry and exit for individuals using wheelchairs, walkers, or those with unsteady gait. It significantly enhances safety and independence.
acceptedAnswer.description: A curbless shower has no raised edge, providing easy and safe entry for those with mobility aids or unsteady gait.
